report.method: Real rendered game; normal HP, damage, movement, collision and weapon logic. Granted tier-5 chassis and tier-1 equipment (within weight capacity) and all 60 unique skills. Replenish defeated enemies to 100 before each step, suppress scheduled elite/boss spawns, consume XP without opening upgrade UI, and refill health in the load controller after recorded hits. Auto-collected inventory cleared by the fixture to prevent overload. Rotating joystick input (no pathfinding in the measurement controller); no further skill/equipment purchases. Frame intervals exclude initial loading and pauses.
